# Hunting in South Dakota

South Dakota is renowned world-wide for its pheasant hunting, and rightfully so. Did you know the average annual pheasant harvest during the past 10 years is 1.2 million roosters?

Pheasants are just part of the hunting package you can enjoy. We offer a variety of game animals across diverse landscapes including: forests, river bottoms, grasslands, wetlands, and the vast Missouri River reservoir system.
